missingSafetyStop.evidence: Stop using the microwave now: switch it off at the socket and unplug it

rationale: The reply gives a strong stop-use and unplug instruction and correctly warns against opening the casing. It is garbled, though: it lists 'A metal object or foil was inside' as a cause even though the customer said nothing about metal, and it repeats the casing warning and the engineer advice. It identifies the side panel as something to check but never names the waveguide cover, never suggests cleaning the cavity or replacing the cover, and sends the customer straight to an engineer, so it is safe but only moderately useful.
